name: Air Fryer Asian-Glazed Chicken Thighs with Brown Rice

components.name: Asian-Glazed Chicken
steps: Mix soy sauce, vinegar, honey, garlic, ginger and sriracha; reserve a portion untouched by raw poultry for the finishing sauce.
Coat the raw thighs with the remaining marinade and chill for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat air fryer to 200 C. Arrange chicken in a single layer, then cook in batches for approximately 14-18 minutes, turning, until each piece reaches 74 C.

components.name: Brown Rice
steps: Simmer reserved clean marinade briefly in a saucepan to reduce to a glaze. Cook brown rice separately with the listed water following rice packet timing.

components.name: Steamed Greens

ingredients.name: Raw green broccoli or bok choy

steps: Steam broccoli or bok choy. Portion four meals with rice, chicken, vegetables and reserved cooked glaze; keep scallion greens separate.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Source chicken and glaze adapted into complete meal with measured brown rice and broccoli. Source protein-only macros do not apply to our complete version.
Planning: Marinate 2+ hours; stovetop rice and glaze, steam vegetables; air fryer multiple batches.
Freezer: chicken and brown rice; vegetables may soften
Dietary: Soy, wheat possible in soy sauce.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
